1.name: The Magician
1.shortDesc: Arcana 1 representing The Magician (Creation, Willpower, Action).

soul.core: In the Soul & Personality zone, The Magician (Arcana 1) governs how you express creation, willpower, action. When active in this area, your life is shaped by themes of cyclic growth, structured decisions, or major transitions relating to this archetype.
soul.shadow: The shadow state of The Magician in your Soul & Personality manifests as a lack of alignment with creation. You may experience internal blockages, resistance to change, or falling into patterns of obsession and fear.
soul.light: To transition to the light state, you must embrace the positive qualities of The Magician. This involves active cultivation of alignment, trusting your inner wisdom, and expressing your natural talents.
soul.advice: Align your actions with the higher octave of Arcana 1 by practicing grounding exercises, releasing control where necessary, and seeking advice that matches this energy.
